name: Critical fumbles
author: Alexandria
summary: A natural 1 on an attack roll has a small mishap the DM picks: a dropped weapon, an opening, a stumble.

rules.text: On a **natural 1 on an attack roll**, the attack misses and the attacker suffers a small mishap the DM picks, never worse than: drop the weapon (it lands at your feet), **provoke an opening** (the next attack against you has advantage), or **stumble** (half speed until your next turn). Spells and checks do not fumble.

assistant.dm: Critical fumbles are on for attack rolls only. On a natural 1 pick one mild mishap: drop the weapon, the next attack against them has advantage, or half speed until their next turn. Never self-damage or hit an ally, and never on spells or checks.
assistant.player: On a natural 1 attack roll at this table the DM picks a small mishap: you drop the weapon, the next attack on you has advantage, or you are at half speed until your next turn.
